summary: Track created from the 2026-09-05 WARC review: seven reproduced defects (copied content-encoding/transfer-encoding/content-length, CDX emits 10 of 11 fields, FNV fallback labelled sha256, missing WARC-Refers-To, reader ignores revisit records, unused --cdx and no .warc.gz support, no request records) encoded as tasks W1-W8 with Files/Change/Verify/Done-when/Do-not contracts. Planning artifacts only; no source changes.

Tasks W1-W4 implemented and verified: stripped wire encoding/framing headers and recalculated Content-Length (W1, AC1), CDX 11-field S record length emission and parsing across writers/reader/MCP (W2, AC2), fail-closed WebCrypto check in sha256Hex (W3, AC3), and WARC-Refers-To tracking on revisit records (W4, AC4). All verifications, station hardening, and leak gates clean.

Task W5 implemented and verified: recordsByDigest tracking and revisit record resolution in WarcReader via WARC-Refers-To-Target-URI and digest payload lookup (W5, AC5). All verifications, station hardening, and leak gates clean.

Tasks W6, W7a, W7b implemented and verified: synthesised request records with WARC-Concurrent-To linkage across JS and Python writers (W6, AC7), warc_verify multi-member .warc.gz container support and request record counting (W7a, AC6), and companion --cdx 11-field record boundary validation (W7b, AC6). All verifications, station hardening, and leak gates clean.
